exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: backyard sensors listening for dark matter's faint signature
forgiveness treated as the bolder move
markets losing their read on AI in a July rout
a Milan and Italy legend passes at 66
mostly clear summer morning in San Francisco, fog still offshore
late July quiet — side projects sleeping, agents waiting on a tap

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Sweep a backyard starfield like a handheld detector — drag to aim at faint blips, release to sample before streetlight noise floods the sensor.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: drag to aim, release to sample
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: Each successful capture fills one stripe of a spectrogram; one round completes a full dark-matter readout.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: False positives from passing cars and porch lights multiply and accelerate.
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: phosphor green oscilloscope on midnight blue

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Two agent lanes propose competing micro-edits to the same codebase — tap the lane with the surgical fix before the wrong branch merges and breaks flow.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: A streak of correct picks feels like staying in flow without leaving context.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Branch count multiplies and the decision window shrinks each merge.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: split-screen terminal diff with neon merge-conflict highlights

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: A debt meter fills relentlessly — hold to apologize sincerely, release at the exact moment humility peaks; too early is hollow, too late is stubborn.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: Nail one perfect forgiveness arc in under a minute.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: Audience size and stakes grow each round while the release window narrows.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: watercolor ink spreading on rice paper

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick striped memorial petals into era slots on a timeline shrine — each petal must land in the correct chapter before the stadium chant fades.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Complete a mini biography arc across four eras in 45 seconds.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Wind gusts and wrong-era slots multiply as the crowd roars louder.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: stadium floodlight silhouettes on grainy Super 8 film
